verdict.why: Queue, Dispatch Namespace and Flagship bindings can now omit the name or ID and get auto-provisioned resources, so a deploy with them omitted now creates resources.

draft.detail: Queue bindings can now omit the resource name.

test.error: FAIL: a Queue producer binding without a queue name is rejected by config validation

source.quote:
Expand automatic resource provisioning to Queue, Dispatch Namespace, and Flagship bindings

  Deployments can now omit the resource name or ID for these bindings.
